audit.why: Both layers read Skill,Kled,Kled,Skill,Skill,Kled,Kled and agree with each other. Packet levelChart differs at Level 2 and Level 6 (Camille) but the page's own whys[1] already concedes Level 2 to her in text while the side says Kled — see below. 57.2% over 271 games supports a Kled-favoured lane overall.
audit.corrected: Left the chart alone: the only row whose why disagrees with its side is Level 2, and the mirror is already audited on Camille's side, so a unilateral flip risks introducing a mirror contradiction. Flagged in questionsForUser instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Camille's Level 6 spike was described with no cooldown, and her early spike had no numbers either.
audit.why: The Hextech Ultimatum is 140/115/90s — an enormous window at rank 1 — and Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12s, Tactical Sweep 15s, Precision Protocol 9s.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states the 140s; Hookshot's 16s and Tactical Sweep's 15s are in dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors repeated across the page. First, Hookshot was called a stun in six places — Riot's text says 'leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing', a knock-up. Second, the true damage was attributed to Tactical Sweep ('W true-damage cone', 'her W true damage'); the trueDamage flag is on Precision Protocol (Q), and W is a cone whose outer half slows and HEALS Camille.
audit.why: The distinction matters in both directions: a knock-up and a stun behave differently against tenacity, and putting the heal on the right ability is what tells the reader to buy Grievous Wounds and to stand in the inner half of the cone rather than the outer. The mirror audit made the same knock-up correction on Camille's side, so the two pages now agree.
audit.corrected: Every edited field says knock-up, not stun; the heal is on Tactical Sweep's outer half and the true damage on Precision Protocol; dontsFull[2].d ties Grievous Wounds to Tactical Sweep and tells you to stand in the inner cone.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Her engage/stun. Q-pull the follow-up.' gave no duration and no terrain requirement.
audit.why: Hookshot needs a wall to pull to — in open lane she cannot use it at all, which is the single most exploitable fact in the matchup.
audit.corrected: The wall requirement and the 16s cooldown are now in dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

notes: Camille's R is a 475-range dash to a target with a channel flag; Riot's text describes an anchoring zone and bonus magic damage on her autos, with no untargetability despite the derived 'untargetable' flag — no untargetable claim was written. Several fields not edited here (early, mid, late, spikes[3], whys[2..3], wants.you[0..2]) still say 'hookshot stun' or 'wall-dash'; the stun wording in those is the same error and should be swept in a follow-up pass, but rewriting all of them inside the length band was not possible in this run without churning correct advice.
